senses.zh: khách đến thăm; người tham quan; du khách
senses.en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.

ex.en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
The museum attracts international visitors by offering exhibitions that explore local history and culture.

tip: visitor chỉ người; visit có thể là động từ hoặc danh từ.

senses.en: a unit of distance equal to one thousand meters

ex.en: The nearest bakery is about a kilometer from here.
Providing reliable public transport within a kilometer of residential areas could reduce dependence on private cars.

tip: Đây là cách viết kiểu Mỹ; kiểu Anh là kilometre, ký hiệu km không thêm s.

senses.en: the end of a person's or animal's life

ex.en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.

col: cause of death｜nguyên nhân tử vong
tip: die là động từ, dead là tính từ, death là danh từ.

senses.en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures
to burst or make a short, sharp sound
to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly

ex.en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.

col: pop a balloon｜làm nổ bóng bay
pop into a shop｜ghé vào cửa hàng
tip: Nghĩa “ghé nhanh” hoặc “nhét nhanh” là cách dùng thân mật, không trang trọng.

senses.zh: tủ bếp; tủ chạn; tủ tường
senses.en: A cabinet with doors and shelves for storing things

ex.en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
Well-designed cupboards can maximise storage space in small apartments without making living areas feel crowded.

tip: Chữ p trong cupboard không phát âm; từ này thường chỉ tủ đựng đồ có cửa.

senses.en: Less good or more unpleasant, harmful, or serious.
Less well or more badly.

ex.en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.

col: even worse｜thậm chí còn tệ hơn
make matters worse｜làm cho tình hình tồi tệ hơn
tip: Là dạng so sánh hơn của bad và badly; dạng so sánh nhất là worst.

senses.zh: tài liệu; giấy tờ; văn bản
senses.en: a paper or digital record containing information
record information about something in writing, photographs, or other forms

ex.en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.

col: document changes｜ghi lại những thay đổi
tip: Động từ kết thúc bằng âm /ment/, danh từ kết thúc bằng /mənt/.

senses.en: A team sport using a bat, ball, and wickets.
A jumping insect that makes a chirping sound.

ex.en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
Team sports such as cricket can help young people develop cooperation skills and build lasting friendships.

tip: Khi chỉ môn thể thao thì không đếm được; khi chỉ con dế thì đếm được.

senses.en: A fish with a cartilage skeleton and usually sharp teeth.

senses.zh: kẻ lừa đảo; kẻ bóc lột
senses.en: Someone who cheats others, especially to get their money.

ex.en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
Protecting shark populations helps maintain balanced marine ecosystems because many species regulate the numbers of other animals.

col: loan shark｜kẻ cho vay nặng lãi
tip: loan shark là kẻ cho vay nặng lãi, không phải một loài cá mập.

senses.en: To decide that something planned will not happen.
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.

tip: Quá khứ tiếng Anh Anh là cancelled, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường là canceled; nghĩa “triệt tiêu” dùng cancel out.

senses.en: How good or bad something is.
A characteristic of a person or thing.
Of a high standard.

ex.en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
Governments should improve the quality of public transport before encouraging people to give up driving.

col: quality of life｜chất lượng cuộc sống
tip: Nghĩa “chất lượng” thường không đếm được; nghĩa “đặc tính, phẩm chất” đếm được.

senses.en: Involving two or more countries.

senses.zh: trận đấu quốc tế; tuyển thủ quốc gia
senses.en: A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.

col: an international flight｜chuyến bay quốc tế
tip: international liên quan đến nhiều nước; domestic nghĩa là trong nước.

senses.en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion.
A particular contest within a sports competition.

ex.en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.

col: organise an event｜tổ chức sự kiện
in the event of｜trong trường hợp xảy ra
tip: in the event of đi với danh từ, nghĩa là “trong trường hợp xảy ra”.

senses.en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement.

senses.zh: dù đến đâu; dù thế nào
senses.en: No matter how much or to what degree.
In any way that someone chooses.

ex.en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
Online courses offer greater flexibility; however, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers.

col: however hard you try｜dù bạn cố gắng thế nào
tip: Khi mang nghĩa “tuy nhiên”, however không phải liên từ nối câu; đừng chỉ dùng dấu phẩy để nối hai câu.

senses.en: being in a place; existing or happening now

senses.zh: trình bày; đưa ra; trao tặng
senses.en: to show, explain or formally give something
something given to someone; the time happening now

ex.en: All the children were present for the class photo.
Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.

tip: Danh từ và tính từ nhấn âm ở âm tiết đầu; động từ nhấn âm ở âm tiết thứ hai.

senses.zh: thuộc châu Á; người châu Á
senses.en: Relating to Asia or its people.

senses.zh: người châu Á; người gốc Á
senses.en: A person from Asia or with family origins there.

ex.en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
Many Asian cities are expanding public transport networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.

col: Asian cultures｜các nền văn hóa châu Á
Asian economies｜các nền kinh tế châu Á
tip: Phải viết hoa chữ cái đầu; Asia là tên châu lục, Asian là tính từ hoặc danh từ chỉ người.

senses.en: the outer form of something
to influence how something develops
to give something a particular physical form

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.

col: in the shape of｜có hình dạng của
stay in shape｜giữ dáng; giữ sức khỏe tốt
tip: in shape có thể chỉ thể trạng tốt, không chỉ nói về hình dạng.

senses.zh: nhà vệ sinh; phòng vệ sinh
senses.en: a room with toilets and facilities for washing hands

ex.en: There is a washroom just beside the lifts.
Every public library should provide an accessible washroom to accommodate visitors with a range of mobility needs.

col: public washroom｜nhà vệ sinh công cộng
accessible washroom｜nhà vệ sinh cho người khuyết tật
washroom facilities｜tiện nghi nhà vệ sinh
tip: Chủ yếu dùng ở Bắc Mỹ, nhất là Canada; ở Anh thường nói toilet.

senses.en: unexpected and causing a feeling of surprise

ex.en: The tiny bakery offers a surprising variety of fresh bread.
The survey revealed a surprising decline in car ownership among young adults living in major cities.

col: surprising results｜kết quả đáng ngạc nhiên
a surprising number of｜một số lượng đáng ngạc nhiên
tip: surprising mô tả sự việc; surprised mô tả cảm giác của người.

senses.en: Having falling snow or frequent snowfall.
Covered with snow.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that snowy afternoon.
In snowy regions, reliable public transport requires regular road maintenance and vehicles designed for winter conditions.

col: snowy mountains｜những ngọn núi phủ tuyết
tip: snowy có thể mô tả thời tiết, cũng có thể chỉ mặt đất hay cảnh vật bị tuyết phủ.

senses.en: a sweet fizzy drink, especially in American English
water containing dissolved gas, often mixed with other drinks

ex.en: I spilled orange soda all over the kitchen floor.
Replacing sugary soda with water can help reduce daily sugar intake and support better dental health.

col: a can of soda｜một lon nước ngọt
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Mỹ, soda thường chỉ nước ngọt có ga; baking soda mới là bột nở.

senses.en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.

ex.en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
Public libraries should be accessible to anybody who wishes to learn, regardless of their income or background.

tip: Khi anybody làm chủ ngữ, động từ chia ở số ít.

senses.en: A game hitting a light ball across a table with bats

senses.zh: chuyển qua lại; qua lại liên tục
senses.en: To move or pass repeatedly back and forth

ex.en: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
Community centres can offer inexpensive activities such as ping-pong to encourage social interaction among older residents.

tip: Mang tính khẩu ngữ; trong thi đấu và văn viết trang trọng thường dùng table tennis.

senses.en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property
to pay to use something owned by someone else
to let someone use your property in exchange for payment

ex.en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
Rising rents in urban areas can force essential workers to live further from their workplaces.

col: rent out a room｜cho thuê phòng
tip: rent có thể là thuê vào hoặc cho thuê; rent out chỉ rõ là cho thuê.

senses.zh: cháu trai (con của anh, chị, em)
senses.en: A son of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

ex.en: My nephew proudly showed me his new bicycle.
Looking after a nephew or niece can help young adults understand the responsibilities of raising children.

col: nieces and nephews｜các cháu trai và cháu gái
tip: nephew chỉ cháu trai; từ tương ứng cho cháu gái là niece.

senses.en: To use physical force against another person or group.

senses.zh: đấu tranh; nỗ lực giành lấy
senses.en: To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal.

senses.zh: cuộc ẩu đả; cuộc đấu tranh
senses.en: An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.

ex.en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.

col: fight for equality｜đấu tranh cho bình đẳng
fight against discrimination｜đấu tranh chống phân biệt đối xử
get into a fight｜dính vào một vụ ẩu đả
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là fought; fight for nghĩa là đấu tranh để giành lấy.

senses.en: To a very great degree.

ex.en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.

tip: Dùng để bổ nghĩa cho tính từ hoặc trạng từ có thể chia mức độ; nhấn mạnh hơn very.

senses.en: the activity of riding and performing tricks on a skateboard

ex.en: We went skateboarding at the park after lunch.
Dedicated skateboarding facilities give young people safe spaces to exercise and develop their balance and coordination.

col: skateboarding facilities｜cơ sở vật chất trượt ván
tip: Môn thể thao dùng skateboarding; còn dụng cụ ván trượt là skateboard.

senses.en: a vegetable with leaves often eaten raw in salads

ex.en: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
Growing lettuce in urban gardens can give residents access to fresh food near their homes.

col: a head of lettuce｜một cây xà lách
tip: Khi chỉ nguyên liệu thường không đếm được; “một cây xà lách” nói là a head of lettuce.

senses.en: Unpleasant to look at.

senses.zh: khó chịu; đáng sợ; dễ gây bạo lực
senses.en: Unpleasant or threatening, especially involving anger or conflict.

ex.en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
Poorly planned developments can create ugly urban landscapes that reduce residents' satisfaction with their neighbourhoods.

col: ugly confrontation｜cuộc đối đầu gay gắt
tip: So sánh hơn là uglier, so sánh nhất là ugliest; nói người khác ugly là bất lịch sự.

senses.en: the achievement of an aim or a desired result
a person or thing that achieves a good result

ex.en: The school concert was a success despite the rain.
Long-term success in education depends not only on funding but also on the quality of teaching.

col: a great success｜một thành công lớn
the key to success｜chìa khóa thành công
tip: Khi nói chung về thành công thì không đếm được; a success chỉ một người hoặc việc thành công.

senses.en: A knitted piece of clothing covering the upper body.

senses.zh: người nhảy; vận động viên nhảy
senses.en: A person or animal that jumps, especially in sport.
A sleeveless dress worn over a shirt or blouse.

ex.en: I packed a warm jumper for the camping trip.
Wearing a jumper indoors can reduce the need for heating during colder months.

col: woollen jumper｜áo len chui đầu bằng len
put on a jumper｜mặc áo len chui đầu
high jumper｜vận động viên nhảy cao
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh dùng jumper cho áo len chui đầu; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng sweater.

senses.en: A length of time or a stage in history.
A scheduled length of time for a school lesson.
The monthly flow of blood from the uterus.

ex.en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.

col: a period of time｜một khoảng thời gian
a transition period｜giai đoạn chuyển tiếp
a historical period｜thời kỳ lịch sử
tip: Chỉ khoảng thời gian thường dùng a period of; tiếng Anh Mỹ còn dùng period cho dấu chấm câu.

senses.en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed.
A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.

ex.en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.

col: a sheet of paper｜một tờ giấy
a sheet of glass｜một tấm kính
tip: sheet là danh từ đếm được; “một tờ giấy” nói là a sheet of paper.

senses.en: A unit of volume equal to one thousand milliliters.

ex.en: This bottle holds exactly one liter of fresh milk.
Measuring household water consumption by the liter can help residents understand how much they use each day.

col: a liter of water｜một lít nước
tip: liter là cách viết kiểu Mỹ, kiểu Anh là litre; một lít bằng một nghìn mi-li-lít.

senses.en: Rest with your body or an object in a flat position
Say something you know is not true
Something untrue that someone says deliberately

ex.en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.

col: lie to someone｜nói dối ai đó
tip: Nghĩa “nằm”: lie–lay–lain; nghĩa “nói dối”: lie–lied–lied.

senses.en: a tall, narrow structure, standing alone or on a building
rise much higher than nearby people or things

ex.en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.

tip: Làm động từ thường đi với over hoặc above, nghĩa là cao vượt hẳn những thứ xung quanh.

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.

ex.en: It was stupid to leave my umbrella at home.
Calling students stupid can damage their confidence and discourage them from asking questions in class.

col: a stupid mistake｜một sai lầm ngu ngốc
a stupid idea｜một ý tưởng ngu ngốc
tip: Gọi thẳng ai đó là stupid là xúc phạm, nên tránh khi nhận xét người khác.

senses.en: At any time, especially in questions and negative statements.
Continuously or always, often describing an ongoing change.

senses.zh: rốt cuộc; đến cùng (nhấn mạnh câu hỏi)
senses.en: Used to emphasize surprise in a question.

ex.en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.

col: ever since｜kể từ đó đến nay
hardly ever｜hầu như không bao giờ
more than ever｜hơn bao giờ hết
ever-growing demand｜nhu cầu ngày càng tăng
tip: Hỏi về trải nghiệm thường dùng Have you ever…; đừng tùy tiện dùng thay cho always trong câu khẳng định.

senses.en: The feeling of being pleased or satisfied with life.

ex.en: Her face shone with happiness when the puppy arrived.
Strong social connections often contribute more to lasting happiness than the purchase of expensive possessions.

col: a sense of happiness｜cảm giác hạnh phúc
tip: Thường không đếm được: dùng happiness, không thêm a.

senses.zh: cháu gái (con của con trai hoặc con gái)
senses.en: The daughter of someone's son or daughter

ex.en: Her granddaughter brought fresh flowers when she visited on Sunday.
Regular contact with a granddaughter or grandson can help older adults feel more connected to family life.

col: granddaughter's birthday｜sinh nhật của cháu gái
tip: Chỉ cả cháu nội gái lẫn cháu ngoại gái; tiếng Anh không phân biệt bên nội hay bên ngoại.

senses.en: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it

ex.en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.

tip: Chỉ người đi trên phương tiện, không gồm người lái hay phi hành đoàn.

senses.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group.
A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.

ex.en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.

col: an article of clothing｜một món quần áo
the definite article｜mạo từ xác định
tip: “Một món quần áo” có thể nói an article of clothing.

senses.en: The main page of a website, linking to other sections.

ex.en: The library's homepage has a photo of its new reading room.
A university homepage should provide clear access to course information, application guidance, and support services for international students.

col: visit the homepage｜truy cập trang chủ
tip: Cũng viết là home page; không phải trang web bất kỳ trong trang web đó.

senses.en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.

ex.en: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.

col: ten percent of｜mười phần trăm của
a five percent increase｜mức tăng năm phần trăm
one hundred percent｜một trăm phần trăm
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh cũng viết per cent; dùng percent để nêu tỷ lệ cụ thể.

senses.en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.

ex.en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.

col: a young teenager｜một thiếu niên nhỏ tuổi
as a teenager｜khi còn là thiếu niên
teenagers' needs｜nhu cầu của thanh thiếu niên
tip: Chỉ người từ 13 đến 19 tuổi, không chỉ chung mọi người chưa thành niên.

senses.en: the way something points, moves, or develops

senses.zh: chỉ dẫn đường đi; hướng dẫn sử dụng
senses.en: instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something

senses.zh: sự chỉ đạo; sự quản lý
senses.en: the control or guidance of an activity or group

ex.en: The dog suddenly ran in the opposite direction.
Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.

col: in the opposite direction｜theo hướng ngược lại
follow the directions｜làm theo hướng dẫn
under the direction of｜dưới sự chỉ đạo của
tip: Khi nói chỉ dẫn đường đi hoặc hướng dẫn thao tác, thường dùng số nhiều directions.

senses.en: in place of someone or something else

ex.en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
Instead of expanding roads, cities should invest in public transport to reduce congestion and pollution.

col: use something instead｜dùng thứ khác thay thế
tip: instead có thể đứng một mình làm trạng từ; instead of đi với danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.

col: amazing results｜kết quả đáng kinh ngạc
an amazing experience｜một trải nghiệm tuyệt vời
tip: amazing mô tả sự vật gây kinh ngạc; amazed mô tả cảm giác của người.

senses.en: A married woman managing her home rather than doing paid work.

ex.en: As a housewife, she manages a busy household.
The unpaid work of a housewife contributes to family welfare but is often excluded from economic statistics.

col: a full-time housewife｜nội trợ toàn thời gian
work as a housewife｜làm nội trợ
tip: Số nhiều là housewives; homemaker là từ không giới hạn giới tính.

senses.en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.

ex.en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.

col: rightful owner｜chủ sở hữu hợp pháp
tip: Muốn nói chủ của vật gì, dùng the owner of + danh từ.

senses.en: A container used for serving or cooking food.
Food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal.
Plates, bowls, and other utensils used for meals.

ex.en: Please put the strawberries in that blue dish.
Traditional dishes can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their distinctive food culture.

tip: a dish có thể chỉ một món ăn; do the dishes nghĩa là rửa bát đĩa.

senses.en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely.
Completely or to the greatest possible degree.

ex.en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.

tip: quite good thường là “khá tốt”; quite impossible nghĩa là “hoàn toàn không thể”.

senses.en: A unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

ex.en: Add one gram of salt and stir the soup.
Comparing the nutrients provided per gram can help consumers make more informed choices about packaged foods.

col: a gram of salt｜một gam muối
tip: Ký hiệu là g; số nhiều là grams; một ki-lô-gam bằng một nghìn gam.

senses.en: A small, flat, sweet baked food

senses.zh: cookie (dữ liệu nhỏ do website lưu trên thiết bị)
senses.en: A small piece of data a website stores on your device

ex.en: There is one chocolate cookie left in the jar.
Websites often use cookies to remember user preferences, but some also track browsing behaviour.

col: chocolate chip cookie｜bánh quy sô-cô-la chip
tip: Tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng cookie để chỉ bánh quy ngọt; cookie của website không phải là tệp bộ nhớ đệm.

senses.en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown
not present where something should be

ex.en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.

col: a missing piece｜một mảnh còn thiếu
tip: missing là tính từ nghĩa “không thấy, thiếu”; be missing from nghĩa là bị thiếu trong cái gì.

senses.en: Located on the left side.

ex.en: Keep your ticket in the left-hand pocket of your jacket.
Separating cyclists from vehicles in the left-hand lane could make this busy road safer for everyone.

col: the left-hand lane｜làn đường bên trái
tip: left-hand chỉ phía bên trái; left-handed chỉ người thuận tay trái.

senses.en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things.
To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly.
Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.

ex.en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.

col: out of pocket｜tự bỏ tiền túi; bị thiệt tiền
tip: pocket money là tiền tiêu vặt, thường dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh.

senses.en: including everything, or complete in degree
the amount obtained by adding everything together
to reach a particular amount or add amounts together

ex.en: The total cost includes breakfast and a bus ticket.
Improving home insulation can reduce total energy consumption while making housing more comfortable throughout the year.

col: total energy consumption｜tổng mức tiêu thụ năng lượng
tip: in total nghĩa là “tổng cộng”; totally thường nghĩa là “hoàn toàn”.

senses.en: a person who serves in an army

ex.en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.

tip: Thường chỉ quân nhân lục quân; thủy thủ và phi công có tên gọi riêng.

senses.en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet

senses.zh: bánh mì tròn nhỏ mềm (tiếng Anh Mỹ)
senses.en: a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast

ex.en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.

col: a packet of biscuits｜một gói bánh quy
tip: biscuit của tiếng Anh Anh thường tương ứng với cookie của tiếng Anh Mỹ; ở Mỹ, biscuit lại là bánh mì mềm.

senses.zh: thuộc châu Phi; người châu Phi
senses.en: relating to Africa or its people
a person from Africa

ex.en: We spotted several African elephants beside a muddy waterhole.
Many African countries are investing in solar energy to improve electricity access in remote rural communities.

col: African wildlife｜động vật hoang dã châu Phi
African languages｜các ngôn ngữ châu Phi
tip: Phải viết hoa chữ cái đầu; từ này chỉ nguồn gốc từ châu Phi, không giới hạn màu da.

senses.zh: phòng tranh; bảo tàng mỹ thuật
senses.en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold.

senses.zh: ban công tầng trên; khu dự thính
senses.en: A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre.
A collection of images available to view, especially online.

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.

col: art gallery｜phòng trưng bày nghệ thuật
public gallery｜khu dự thính công cộng
tip: gallery chủ yếu trưng bày tác phẩm nghệ thuật; museum có phạm vi hiện vật rộng hơn.

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.

tip: Dùng fat để tả người có thể gây khó chịu; khi nói về sức khỏe nên dùng overweight.

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.

col: on sale｜đang bán; đang giảm giá
a clearance sale｜đợt xả hàng tồn kho
tip: for sale nghĩa là đang rao bán; doanh số hoặc lượng bán thường dùng số nhiều sales.

senses.en: The activity of moving over snow on skis.

ex.en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
Skiing attracts winter tourists to mountain regions, creating seasonal jobs but increasing demand for water.

col: skiing lessons｜các lớp học trượt tuyết
tip: Nói go skiing cho trượt tuyết; trượt nước phải nói water skiing.

senses.en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.

ex.en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.

col: reset a password｜đặt lại mật khẩu
password protection｜bảo vệ bằng mật khẩu
tip: password là mật khẩu; passcode cũng có thể chỉ mã số.

senses.en: A public box where people put mail to be collected.

ex.en: I dropped the birthday card into the postbox outside.
Keeping a postbox within walking distance helps residents without internet access maintain contact with essential services.

col: put something in a postbox｜bỏ vật gì vào hòm thư
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh chỉ hòm thư công cộng để gửi thư; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng mailbox.

senses.en: the final part of a story, event, or activity
a final word part that often shows grammatical information

ex.en: The film had a surprisingly cheerful ending for everyone.
An ambiguous ending can encourage readers to question their assumptions and consider alternative interpretations of a novel.

col: a happy ending｜kết thúc có hậu
a surprise ending｜kết thúc bất ngờ
tip: Kết cục của câu chuyện dùng ending; at the end nghĩa là ở cuối.

senses.zh: ủng hộ; giúp đỡ; chu cấp
senses.en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone
to hold something up or bear its weight

senses.zh: sự ủng hộ; sự hỗ trợ; vật chống đỡ
senses.en: help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up

ex.en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.

col: support an argument｜đưa ra căn cứ cho một lập luận
tip: support là ngoại động từ; danh từ thường đi với support for.

senses.en: An aircraft with rotating blades that can rise straight upwards.

ex.en: A helicopter landed in the field behind our house.
A rescue helicopter can reach isolated communities when floods make roads unsafe for emergency vehicles.

tip: Đi bằng trực thăng dùng by helicopter, ở giữa không có mạo từ.

senses.en: not neat or well arranged
not keeping your belongings or surroundings neat

ex.en: Her untidy desk was covered with cups and notebooks.
Shared workspaces can quickly become untidy unless employees take responsibility for keeping communal areas clean and organised.

col: an untidy room｜căn phòng bừa bộn
an untidy desk｜bàn làm việc lộn xộn
tip: untidy nhấn mạnh sự không ngăn nắp, không nhất thiết bẩn như dirty.

senses.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

ex.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.

tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường nói football, tiếng Anh Mỹ nói soccer.

senses.en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg
the enclosed storage space at the back of a car
to start a computer and load its operating system

ex.en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.

col: a pair of boots｜một đôi bốt
boot up a computer｜khởi động máy tính
tip: Cốp xe ô tô tiếng Anh Anh là boot, tiếng Anh Mỹ là trunk.

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound
to contact someone by telephone

ex.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.

col: give someone a ring｜gọi điện cho ai
a ring of trees｜một vòng cây
tip: Với nghĩa rung chuông và gọi điện, quá khứ là rang, quá khứ phân từ là rung.

senses.zh: hệ thống sưởi; sự sưởi ấm
senses.en: The system or process that keeps a building warm.
The process of making something warmer.

ex.en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
Improving home insulation can reduce heating costs and lower the environmental impact of household energy consumption.

col: central heating｜hệ thống sưởi trung tâm
tip: Khi chỉ hệ thống sưởi thì thường không đếm được: turn on the heating.

senses.en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns
to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco
to produce smoke

ex.en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.

tip: Nghĩa “khói” thường không đếm được; smoky nghĩa là đầy khói.

senses.zh: bản ghi âm; bản ghi hình
senses.en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing

senses.zh: việc ghi âm; sự ghi chép
senses.en: the process of saving sounds, images, or information

ex.en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.

col: make a recording｜ghi âm; ghi hình
tip: Một bản ghi âm là danh từ đếm được; khi chỉ quá trình ghi thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: describing a place where smoking is not allowed
describing someone who does not smoke

ex.en: We asked for a non-smoking room at reception.
Non-smoking areas in public buildings help protect visitors and employees from exposure to tobacco smoke.

col: non-smoking area｜khu vực cấm hút thuốc
non-smoking household｜gia đình không ai hút thuốc
tip: Có thể chỉ nơi cấm hút thuốc, cũng có thể chỉ người không hút thuốc.

senses.en: a code identifying a postal delivery area

ex.en: Please include your postcode when you fill in the form.
Researchers used postcode data to compare access to public transport across different residential areas.

col: enter a postcode｜nhập mã bưu chính
postcode area｜khu vực mã bưu chính
postcode search｜tra cứu mã bưu chính
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng postcode; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng ZIP code.

senses.en: Having pale yellow hair, or describing this hair colour.
A woman or girl with pale yellow hair.

ex.en: Her blonde hair shone brightly in the afternoon sun.
Films that repeatedly associate blonde hair with particular personalities can reinforce unfair stereotypes about appearance.

tip: blonde thường dùng cho nữ; tả nam giới thường dùng blond.

senses.en: Let someone use something temporarily, expecting its return.
Give support or add a particular quality to something.

ex.en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.

col: lend someone something｜cho ai mượn thứ gì
lend money to｜cho ai vay tiền
tip: lend là cho mượn, borrow là mượn; quá khứ của lend là lent.

senses.en: A light shoe with straps that leaves much of the foot uncovered.

ex.en: A small stone got stuck inside my sandal.
In warm climates, sandals are popular because their open design allows air to circulate around the feet.

col: a pair of sandals｜một đôi xăng-đan
tip: Một chiếc là sandal, một đôi là a pair of sandals.

senses.en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something
money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings
to make someone want to know or learn more

ex.en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.

col: take an interest in｜quan tâm đến
tip: Hứng thú dùng interest in; các sở thích cụ thể dùng số nhiều interests.

senses.en: No longer alive
No longer working, often because power has run out
Completely or exactly, used for emphasis

ex.en: We removed the dead flowers from the balcony pots.
Leaving dead trees in forests can support biodiversity by providing habitats for insects and small animals.

col: dead silence｜sự im lặng tuyệt đối
tip: dead là trạng thái, die là hành động, death là danh từ.

senses.en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat

senses.zh: cúi xuống né; nghiêng người tránh
senses.en: Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something
Avoid a difficult question, responsibility, or situation

ex.en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.

col: duck your head｜cúi đầu xuống nhanh
duck a question｜né tránh một câu hỏi
tip: Khi chỉ con vịt thì đếm được, khi chỉ thịt vịt thì không đếm được.

senses.zh: nghĩa là; có nghĩa là; định
senses.en: to express, involve, or intend something
unkind or unwilling to share or spend money
the total of several values divided by how many exist

ex.en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.

col: mean to do something｜định làm việc gì
mean doing something｜có nghĩa là phải làm gì
be mean to someone｜xấu tính với ai
tip: mean to do là “định làm”; mean doing là “đồng nghĩa với việc phải làm”.

senses.en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping
something you strongly hope to achieve or experience
to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want

ex.en: Last night, I had a dream about flying over mountains.
Access to affordable education allows more young people to pursue their dream of entering a skilled profession.

col: pursue a dream｜theo đuổi ước mơ
dream of becoming｜mơ ước trở thành
a dream come true｜ước mơ thành hiện thực
tip: dream of/about đi với danh từ hoặc danh động từ; quá khứ có thể là dreamt hoặc dreamed.

senses.en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events.
Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement.
Someone who often visits the same place.

ex.en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.

col: regular exercise｜tập thể dục đều đặn
at regular intervals｜cách quãng đều nhau
a regular pattern｜một mẫu đều đặn
tip: regular nhấn vào sự đều đặn hoặc thường xuyên, khác với continuous là liên tục không ngừng.

senses.en: A set of steps connecting different levels of a building.

ex.en: We carried the heavy suitcase up the narrow stairs.
Public buildings should provide lifts alongside stairs to ensure equal access for people with limited mobility.

col: a flight of stairs｜một dãy cầu thang
take the stairs｜đi cầu thang bộ
tip: stairs là số nhiều, động từ chia số nhiều; “một đợt cầu thang” nói là a flight of stairs.

senses.en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer
Recognize that something is true or valid
Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation

ex.en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.

col: accept an offer｜chấp nhận đề nghị
tip: Chấp nhận lời đề nghị dùng accept; accept khác với receive, vốn chỉ đơn thuần là nhận được.

senses.zh: ở nước ngoài; ra nước ngoài
senses.en: in or to a foreign country

ex.en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.

col: travel abroad｜đi du lịch nước ngoài
tip: abroad là trạng từ: nói go abroad, không nói go to abroad.

senses.zh: tham dự; có mặt; đi học
senses.en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution
to deal with something or care for someone

ex.en: My sister attends a dance class every Saturday morning.
Students who attend lectures regularly are more likely to understand difficult concepts and complete assignments successfully.

col: attend a meeting｜tham dự cuộc họp
attend to a problem｜giải quyết vấn đề
tip: Tham dự sự kiện thì đi thẳng với tân ngữ; xử lý hoặc chăm sóc dùng attend to.

senses.zh: mua mang đi; đồ ăn mang đi
senses.en: to buy prepared food and eat it somewhere else
to remove something from a place or person

ex.en: Could I have a vegetable sandwich to take away?
Restaurants should offer reusable containers to customers who buy meals to take away, reducing packaging waste.

col: food to take away｜đồ ăn mang đi
take away the plates｜dọn đĩa đi
take away someone's rights｜tước quyền của ai
tip: take away là cụm động từ; danh từ chỉ món ăn mang đi viết là takeaway.

senses.en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar

ex.en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.

col: a piece of candy｜một viên kẹo
tip: Tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng candy, tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng sweets; “một viên” dùng a piece of.

senses.en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something.
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.

tip: Danh từ “những điều cơ bản” dùng số nhiều the basics.

senses.en: For everyone to use, see, or know about.
Provided or controlled by the government.
Ordinary people in society considered as a group.

ex.en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.

col: the general public｜công chúng nói chung
tip: the public chỉ công chúng; in public nghĩa là ở nơi công cộng.

senses.en: A document that allows a passenger to board a plane.

ex.en: Keep your boarding card handy until you reach your seat.
Passengers can now download a boarding card, reducing paper consumption and waiting times at airport counters.

col: show your boarding card｜xuất trình thẻ lên máy bay
print a boarding card｜in thẻ lên máy bay
electronic boarding card｜thẻ lên máy bay điện tử
tip: Đây là thẻ lên máy bay, không phải vé máy bay; boarding pass cũng rất thông dụng.

senses.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.
Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.

ex.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.

tip: Thường không đếm được; là từ quen thuộc trong tiếng Anh Anh, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng garbage hoặc trash.

senses.en: a room with toilets in a public place

ex.en: I stopped at the restroom before boarding the bus.
Providing a clean public restroom near busy transport hubs improves comfort for commuters and tourists alike.

col: public restroom｜nhà vệ sinh công cộng
restroom facilities｜tiện nghi nhà vệ sinh
accessible restroom｜nhà vệ sinh cho người khuyết tật
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Mỹ chỉ nhà vệ sinh công cộng, không phải phòng nghỉ thông thường.
